aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Reconcile with Settlement Return Logistics
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  'Other Charges (invoice-level)' AS source,
  SUM(taxable_value) AS total_reverse_logistics
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses
WHERE is_active = true AND LOWER(type) = 'reverse_shipping'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Settlement (order-level)',
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax)
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status IN ('Return', 'RTO');
